51839-nacogdoches.title: Nacogdoches
51839-nacogdoches.creator: R. B. Blake
51839-nacogdoches.description: A book by R. B. Blake. teel And taut heart-strings: wild wills, who thought to deal Bare-handed with jade Fortune, tracked at last Out of her silken lairs into the vast Of a man’s world. They passed, but still I feel The dint of hoof, the print of booted heel, Like prick of spurs—the shadows that they cast.

arxiv-2103-08562.title: Deep Learning-based Patient Re-identification Is able to Exploit the Biometric Nature of Medical Chest X-ray Data
arxiv-2103-08562.creator: Kai Packhäuser, Sebastian Gündel, Nicolas Münster, Christopher Syben, Vincent Christlein, Andreas Maier
arxiv-2103-08562.description: Abstract With the rise and ever-increasing potential of deep learning techniques in recent years, publicly available medical datasets became a key factor to enable reproducible development of diagnostic algorithms in the medical domain. Medical data contains sensitive patient-related information and is therefore usually anonymized by removing patient identifiers, e. g., patient names before publication.

arxiv-2107-10736.title: On the Schrödinger Operator with a Periodic PT-symmetric Matrix Potential
arxiv-2107-10736.creator: O. A. Veliev
arxiv-2107-10736.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by O. A. Veliev. In this article we obtain asymptotic formulas for the Bloch eigenvalues of the operator L L generated by a system of Schrödinger equations with periodic PT-symmetric complex-valued coefficients. Then using these formulas we classify the spectrum σ ⁡ ( L ) \sigma(L) of L L and find a condition on the coefficients for which σ ⁡ ( L ) \sigma(L) contains all half line [ H , ∞ ) [H,\infty) for some H .

arxiv-2210-06930.title: Identification of exciton complexes in a charge-tuneable Janus W S Se {}_{\mathrm{Se}}^{\mathrm{S}} monolayer
arxiv-2210-06930.creator: Matthew S. G. Feuer, Alejandro R.-P. Montblanch, Mohammed Sayyad, Carola M. Purser, Ying Qin, Evgeny M. Alexeev, Alisson R. Cadore, Barbara L. T. Rosa, James Kerfoot, Elaheh Mostaani, Radosław Kalęba, Pranvera Kolari, Jan Kopaczek, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Andrea C. Ferrari, Dhiren M. Kara
arxiv-2210-06930.description: Abstract Janus transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers are fully artificial materials, where one plane of chalcogen atoms is replaced by chalcogen atoms of a different type. Theory predicts an in-built out-of-plane electric field, giving rise to long-lived, dipolar excitons, while preserving direct-bandgap optical transitions in a uniform potential landscape.

arxiv-2404-09747.title: Optimizing Off-Axis Fields for Two-Axis Magnetometry with Point Defects
arxiv-2404-09747.creator: N. M. Beaver, N. Voce, P. Meisenheimer, R. Ramesh, P. Stevenson
arxiv-2404-09747.description: Abstract Vector magnetometry is an essential tool in characterizing the distribution of currents and magnetization in a broad range of systems. Point defect sensors, like the nitrogen vacancy (NV) center in diamond, have demonstrated impressive sensitivity and spatial resolution for detecting these fields.

arxiv-2501-02629.title: Layer-Level Self-Exposure and Patch: Affirmative Token Mitigation for Jailbreak Attack Defense
arxiv-2501-02629.creator: Yang Ouyang, Hengrui Gu, Shuhang Lin, Wenyue Hua, Jie Peng, Bhavya Kailkhura, Meijun Gao, Tianlong Chen, Kaixiong Zhou
arxiv-2501-02629.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in diverse applications, including chatbot assistants and code generation, aligning their behavior with safety and ethical standards has become paramount. However, jailbreak attacks, which exploit vulnerabilities to elicit unintended or harmful outputs, threaten LLMs safety significantly.

arxiv-2502-08567.title: Statistically validated projection of bipartite signed networks
arxiv-2502-08567.creator: Anna Gallo, Fabio Saracco, Tiziano Squartini
arxiv-2502-08567.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anna Gallo, Fabio Saracco, Tiziano Squartini. Bipartite networks provide a major insight into the organisation of many real-world systems. One of the most relevant issues encountered when modelling a bipartite network is that of facing the information shortage concerning intra-layer linkages. In the present contribution, we propose an unsupervised algorithm to obtain statistically validated projections of bipartite signed networks, according to which any two nodes sharing a statistically significant number of concordant (discordant) relationships are connected by a positive (negative) edge.

arxiv-2511-14377.title: Magnetic Fields in the Shapley Supercluster Core with POSSUM: Challenging Model Predictions
arxiv-2511-14377.creator: D. Alonso-López, S. P. O’Sullivan, A. Bonafede, L. M. Böss, C. Stuardi, E. Osinga, C. S. Anderson, C. L. Van Eck, E. Carretti, J. L. West, T. Akahori, K. Dolag, S. Giacintucci, A. Khadir, Y. K. Ma, S. Malik, N. McClure-Griffiths, L. Rudnick, B. A. Seidel, S. Tiwari, T. Venturi
arxiv-2511-14377.description: Abstract Context. Faraday Rotation Measure (RM) Grids provide a sensitive means to trace magnetized plasma across a wide range of cosmic environments. Aims. We study the RM signal from the Shapley Supercluster Core (SSC), in order to constrain the magnetic field properties of the gas.

europmc-pmc2702684.title: Emergence of a stable cortical map for neuroprosthetic control.
europmc-pmc2702684.creator: Ganguly K, Carmena JM.
europmc-pmc2702684.description: Cortical control of neuroprosthetic devices is known to require neuronal adaptations. It remains unclear whether a stable cortical representation for prosthetic function can be stored and recalled in a manner that mimics our natural recall of motor skills. Especially in light of

plos-pone-0005787.title: Differential Role of Autophagy in CD4 T Cells and Macrophages during X4 and R5 HIV-1 Infection
plos-pone-0005787.creator: Lucile Espert, Mihayl Varbanov, Véronique Robert-Hebmann et al.
plos-pone-0005787.description: PLOS ONE research article. HIV-1 can infect and replicate in both CD4 T cells and macrophages. In these cell types, HIV-1 entry is mediated by the binding of envelope glycoproteins (gp120 and gp41, Env) to the receptor CD4 and a coreceptor, principally CCR5 or CXCR4, depending on the viral strain (R5 or X4

pmc-10498572.title: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of the gingival: a rare case report and review of the literature
pmc-10498572.creator: Jiaqi Li, Zhijian Zheng, Hao Deng, Yi Men, Yu Chen, Qi Han
pmc-10498572.description: BackgroundExtraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma (EMC) is a rare malignant tumor described in the head and neck region, especially in the gingival. We present one case arising in the gingival of right mandible, and briefly reviewed the related literature.Case presentationA 24-year-old male patient with a lesion of 3.5*2.0 cm in buccal gingival of right posterior mandible for 2 months.

pmc-10534436.title: Effects of Indonesian Shortfin Eel (Anguilla bicolor) By-Product Oil Supplementation on HOMA-IR and Lipid Profile in Obese Male Wistar Rats
pmc-10534436.creator: Ginna Megawati, Siti Shofiah Syahruddin, Winona Tjandra, Maya Kusumawati, Dewi Marhaeni Diah Herawati, Dida Achmad Gurnida, Ida Musfiroh, Hyun-Gyun Yuk, Pujie Shi, Tiantian Lin, Lin Chen, Xin Yang, Caili Fu, Rong Fan
pmc-10534436.description: The prevalence of people being overweight and obese has increased globally over the past decades. The use of omega-3 fatty acids—a compound usually primarily found in fish oil—has been known to improve the metabolic profile of obese patients. As the demand for eels increases, the number of waste products from the eels increases and creates environmental problems.

pmc-11313465.title: Improving Movement Behavior in People after Stroke with the RISE Intervention: A Randomized Multiple Baseline Study
pmc-11313465.creator: Wendy Hendrickx, Roderick Wondergem, Cindy Veenhof, Coralie English, Johanna M A Visser-Meily, Martijn F Pisters, Syoichi Tashiro
pmc-11313465.description: Objective: High amounts of sedentary behavior increase the risk of cardiovascular disease. This study aimed to determine the preliminary effectiveness and feasibility of the RISE intervention to support community-dwelling people with stroke, who are highly sedentary, to reduce and interrupt sedentary time. Additionally, the added value of including participatory support was determined.

pmc-11616146.title: Management of atraumatic chin-on-chest deformity in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma: illustrative case
pmc-11616146.creator: Helen Karimi, Rahul A. Sastry, Belinda Shao, Hael Abdulrazeq, Xun Li, Tianyi Niu
pmc-11616146.description: BACKGROUNDPatients with multiple myeloma (MM) are commonly managed by multidisciplinary oncology teams in concordance with the neurological, oncological, mechanical, and systematic decision framework. Surgery is indicated for mechanical instability and/or neurological deficits. In neurologically intact and mechanically stable patients, chemo- and radiotherapy alone are often the mainstay treatment.

pmc-11620617.title: Raman‐Enabled Predictions of Protein Content and Metabolites in Biopharmaceutical Saccharomyces cerevisiae Fermentations
pmc-11620617.creator: Jeppe Hagedorn, Guilherme Ramos, Miguel Ressurreição, Ernst Broberg Hansen, Michael Sokolov, Carlos Casado Vázquez, Christos Panos
pmc-11620617.description: Raman spectroscopy, a robust and non‐invasive analytical method, has demonstrated significant potential for monitoring biopharmaceutical production processes. Its ability to provide detailed information about molecular vibrations makes it ideal for the detection and quantification of therapeutic proteins and critical control parameters in complex biopharmaceutical mixtures.

pmc-11621481.title: Combined Dupilumab and Allergen-Specific Immunotherapy in Severe Refractory Atopic Dermatitis
pmc-11621481.creator: Jemin Kim, Jihee Boo, Hyunwoo Jang, Yeon Woo Jung, Jihee Kim, KeLun Zhang, Chang Ook Park
pmc-11621481.description: Although combining allergen immunotherapy with biologics has shown promise in treating atopic diseases such as asthma and allergic rhinitis, atopic dermatitis (AD) remains notably underexplored in this context. This study aimed to investigate the efficacy and safety of combining dupilumab with subcutaneous immunotherapy (SCIT) for severe AD refractory to standard treatments.

pmc-11641285.title: Role of Myeloid Cell-Specific Adenylyl Cyclase Type 7 in Lipopolysaccharide- and Alcohol-Induced Immune Responses
pmc-11641285.creator: Yawen Hu, Sonika Patial, Yogesh Saini, Masami Yoshimura, Babak Baban, Maria Pascual
pmc-11641285.description: Clinical and experimental evidence indicates that alcohol use causes various abnormalities in the immune system and compromises immune functions. However, the mechanistic understanding of ethanol’s effects on the immune system remains limited. Cyclic AMP (cAMP) regulates multiple processes, including immune responses. Earlier research indicated that type 7 adenylyl cyclase (AC7) regulates the immune system and is highly responsive to ethanol.

pmc-12442494.title: Therapeutic efficacy of Nigella sativa and Ziziphus lotus: sustainable strategies for diabetes, antimicrobial resistance, and health treatment
pmc-12442494.creator: Alaa S. Bedir, Razan S. Almasri, Seham M. Al Raish
pmc-12442494.description: The pharmacological potential of Nigella sativa and Ziziphus lotus, two medicinal plants native to the United Arab Emirates (UAE), is explored in the context of sustainable healthcare strategies. Both plants have demonstrated notable antidiabetic and antimicrobial effects in preclinical studies.

pmc-12466728.title: Exploring the Impact of Organizational Identification on Innovative Work Behavior in the Korean Public Sector: The Moderating Role of Charismatic Leadership
pmc-12466728.creator: Kuk-Kyoung Moon, Jaeyoung Lim
pmc-12466728.description: Public sector organizations increasingly face demands for innovation. However, the hierarchical and rule-bound nature of bureaucracy can hinder employees’ ability to engage in creative and change-oriented behavior. This study investigates how organizational identification—a psychological sense of oneness with the organization—is associated with innovative work behavior among South Korean public officials and how this relationship is moderated by charismatic leadership.

pmc-12586224.title: Longitudinal tractography of the mouse corpus callosum reveals topographical order and differences due to sex and aging
pmc-12586224.creator: Özgün Özalay, Tomas Mediavilla, Bruno Lima Giacobbo, Daniel Marcellino, Greger Orädd, Anna Rieckmann, Fahad Sultan
pmc-12586224.description: The corpus callosum (CC) is the major tract connecting the two hemispheres in placental mammals and diffusion-weighted (DWI) MRI has revealed the meso/macroscopic organization of human CC and its organization of connectivity with the cortex. Here, we applied longitudinal DWI probabilistic tractography to study the CC fibers of mice across the adult lifespan.

pmc-13546975.title: Commercial Payors More Likely to Reimburse Unlisted Hip Arthroscopy Procedures Compared With Managed Care but With Similar Overall Dollar Amount
pmc-13546975.creator: Eric V. Neufeld, Matthew Zinner, Michael J. Meade, Randy M. Cohn, Andrew D. Goodwillie
pmc-13546975.description: PurposeTo compare the reimbursement practices of public managed care (MC) insurance versus private commercial insurance (COM) for hip arthroscopy using the current procedural terminology (CPT) code 29999.MethodsThe CPT codes and corresponding reimbursements of hip arthroscopies that employed code 29999 performed from January 2020 to December 2024 in a multihospital health system were analyzed.

pmc-13663412.title: From In Vitro Screening to In Vivo Evaluation of Essential-Oil-Based Formulation Against Avian Pathogenic Escherichia coli
pmc-13663412.creator: Milenko Rikić, Zoran Ružić, Marko Pajić, Dalibor Todorović, Slobodan Knežević, Nebojša Kladar, Zorana Kovačević
pmc-13663412.description: Simple SummaryAvian pathogenic Escherichia coli (APEC) is an important cause of colibacillosis in poultry, while increasing antimicrobial resistance highlights the need for alternative approaches to disease control. Essential oils have attracted interest due to their potential antibacterial properties and possible application in poultry production.
